messages:
morgan: FYI PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 - includes JSON Schema for structured outputs, a TS + Python parsing snippet, and a short migration note for function-calling. Need SDK sample check + link fixes. PTAL @jess @kai

jess: looking

kai: quick q — do we require additionalProperties: false on root schema? That broke one test for me earlier

sam: recommend we allow unknown keys in top-level to be forgiving, but enforce required/patterns for known fields. i added a comment in the PR explaining tradeoffs.

jess: saw that. Also a nit: in TS snippet we import `openai` — should be `@redwood/inference` in examples. I'll push a tiny commit unless someone objects

morgan: please push, thanks

kai: on validator: use ajv with keywords: {strict:false}. Suggest snippet:
```
const Ajv = require('ajv');
const ajv = new Ajv({allErrors: true, removeAdditional: false});
const validate = ajv.compile(schema);
```

jess: +1. Also add snippet for using the SDK streaming parse example. Eg:
```
const r = await client.responses.create({input, tools});
for await (const chunk of r.stream()) { parseChunk(chunk) }
```

olivia: docs-bot deployed preview at https://deploy-preview-482--docs.redwood.com, screenshots/examples look fine but one link is 404 (line 72, "function-calling migration" link)

morgan: thanks — i'll fix links. who's taking the migration guide edit to add a short paragraph about 'when to prefer function calling vs structured output'?

sam: i'll draft that paragraph. aim for 2–3 sentences + example

jess: review done, left two tiny comments, one about code style and one about wording. LGTM after those.

morgan: great. sam please add paragraph and i'll merge after jess's nits

sam: added and pushed. also added a TS SDK snippet showing schema guardrail injection:
```
const prompt = buildPrompt(schema, examples);
await client.responses.create({input: prompt, options: {guardrails: [{schema}]}})
```

kai: can we add a short mention about parsing partial streams and KV cache for chat? might be out-of-scope

morgan: out of scope for this PR. let's do a follow-up doc. filed task #764 to track.

jess: merging now :shipit:

docs-bot: PR merged by jess into main — deploy scheduled

morgan: thanks team :tada:
